metadata.description: Limelit plugins for AI search visibility: free site audits for AI crawlers and llms.txt, plus Limelit Cloud and Limelit Open connected to Claude.

plugins.name: limelit-audit
plugins.description: Free AI search audits with no account: which AI crawlers your robots.txt lets in, and whether your llms.txt is present and well formed.

plugins.name: limelit
plugins.description: Connect Limelit Cloud: see how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI answers rank and cite your brand against competitors, and what to fix next.

plugins.name: limelit-open
plugins.description: Connect a self-hosted Limelit Open install: your own AI visibility tracking, read from Claude over the local limelit binary.
